metadata.title: CS229 Machine Learning — Unofficial Audio Preservation Edition
metadata.creator: Andrew Ng (lecturer)
metadata.description: A non-commercial, independent audio preservation of the 20-lecture Stanford CS229 Machine Learning course taught by Andrew Ng. The source lecture series is from Autumn 2007 and was published through the Stanford Engineering Everywhere initiative launched in 2008. The original AAC-LC audio streams were copied into M4A containers without re-encoding; video was removed and preservation metadata and original artwork were added. Original lectures © Stanford University and/or identified rights holders and made available through Stanford Engineering Everywhere under CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 unless expressly indicated otherwise. Audio-only format conversion, added metadata, and original artwork are distributed under the same licence. This independent project relies on SEE's published reuse terms. No separate authorization, affiliation, official status, or endorsement by Stanford University or Andrew Ng has been obtained or is claimed. No monetization, advertising, sponsorship, or commercial purpose.
